name: prismantis-skins-helper
description: Vertical breathing room around transcript elements, and never collapse tool groups. Wraps prismantis and skins rather than replacing them.

replyGap.title: Gap above replies
replyGap.description: A blank line above the start of each reply, so it is not flush against your prompt or the last tool row.

durationGap.title: Gap above the duration line
durationGap.description: A blank line above the "Cooked for 12s" line at the end of a turn.

spinnerGap.title: Gap above the spinner
spinnerGap.description: A blank line above the working spinner, so it is not flush against the text above it.

expandToolGroups.title: Never collapse tool groups
expandToolGroups.description: Every tool call draws as its own row. Without this, skins replaces a batch with a tally like "Run 3" and hides the commands.
